title: Longest Word With All Prefixes
summary: Given an array of strings, identify the longest string where all its prefixes are also present in the array.
statement: Given an array of strings, identify the longest string where all its prefixes are also present in the array. If multiple strings have the same length, choose the lexicographically smallest one. Return an empty string if no such string exists.
constraints: A word qualifies only when every nonempty prefix is also present in words.
Return the longest qualifying word, breaking ties lexicographically; return empty string if none.
hints: A set can answer whether each required prefix exists.
Check prefixes of every candidate and compare only fully buildable words.
Prefer greater length, then smaller lexicographic order.
The predicate directly matches the definition, and the two-part comparison preserves exactly the required winner among all qualifying words.
editorial: The predicate directly matches the definition, and the two-part comparison preserves exactly the required winner among all qualifying words.

tests.explanation: Every prefix of kiran is present, so kiran wins.
apple and apply qualify, and apple is lexicographically smaller.
